name: Fib Feast
source:
In a post-apocalyptic alien world, you play a hungry alien.

Tell a lie or tell the truth. It's up to you.

[From [url=https://gleamiarts.itch.io/fib-feast]itch.io[/url]]

說謊，還是說真話？由你決定。
